description: This file implements the RunC container management logic, including classes for container control, configuration, and runtime interactions via the runc CLI. It defines methods for creating, starting, stopping, and querying container state, as well as handling environment variables and configuration files.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Handles interactions with the runc CLI, including creating, executing, deleting, and querying container states.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a runc-managed container, providing methods to start, stop, and retrieve container info.

classes.name: RunCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Factory class responsible for initializing and creating runc containers based on configuration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the container administrator, retrieves runc version.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a container object based on configuration files found in search paths.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID of the container if running.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, optionally with a timeout.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Returns memory usage info of the container.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Returns CPU/processor info of the container.

methods.name: NetworkInterfaces
methods.description: Returns network interfaces associated with the container.

methods.name: InternalPurge
methods.description: Deletes the container if it is running.
